description: This Java source file defines an immutable implementation of the MappingContext interface, providing methods for creating, serializing, and accessing mapping context data including conditions, options, and engine type. It also includes a nested Builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: ImmutableMappingContext
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the MappingContext interface, encapsulating mapping engine details, options, and conditions with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: ImmutableMappingContext.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing ImmutableMappingContext instances.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableMappingContext instance from provided mapping engine string and options JSON.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a MappingContext instance from a JSON object representation.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the MappingContext to a JSON object, respecting schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns the map of incoming conditions.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns the map of outgoing conditions.
